name: STAR Geodesy — geodesic distance and azimuth on WGS-84 (direct and inverse)
summary: Inverse and direct geodesic problems on WGS-84 with bounded iterations: measured within 0.08 mm of PROJ, GeographicLib and PyGeodesy; nearly antipodal points are refused, an unconverged value is never returned.
reference: Flinders Peak - Buninyong line (Geoscience Australia / ICSM GDA technical manual): 54972.271 m, forward azimuth 306 52 05.37, reverse azimuth 127 10 25.07
reference_observed: distance within 1.4e-4 m, azimuths within 0.0032 arcsec; direct problem reaches Buninyong within 1.2e-4 arcsec

na.G-14: no performance requirement declared by any user

review.G-04: degrees and metres; azimuth from North towards East in [0, 360); longitude out in [-180, 180); WGS-84 constants pinned in the tests
review.G-06: no external data; cross-check corpus generated with a fixed seed
review.G-08: pure functions, standard library only, no IO
review.G-13: ValueError for invalid input, RuntimeError for antipodal or non-convergent cases, iterations bounded at 200
